root_cause: The existing advisory comparator rejected MAIN_SYNC reconciliation when the permitted second drift refresh was already consumed. Its age-first ordering promoted historical PRs with no recent positive Required evidence ahead of current release candidates.
fix: Treat MAIN_SYNC with exactly two prior refreshes as eligible for reconciliation only, never another CAS write. Rank idle terminal leases with distinct provider-observed exact-head Required success ahead of bounded-sample unknowns; for other eligible idle leases prefer recently updated candidates. Preserve original order for unrankable PRs and all incumbent live gates.
prevention_rule: MAIN_SYNC reconciliation is not a third write; a TERMINAL_DELIVERY lease with count=2 remains exhausted. Provider samples are bounded: absence of a run is UNKNOWN. Never bypass current-head Required, CodeQL, native expected_head_sha, lease/overlap checks, source or production readback.

expected_behaviors: existing MAIN_SYNC attempt-two is ranked for only reconciliation
terminal leases at drift-two cannot begin third update
completed exact-head Required success informs priority but not merge authorization
unknown provider observations are not converted to failed or green
